storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Modern Story
storyTemplate.description: A grounded modern start: arrive in a new city, find your contact, and get your first local lead.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The bus pulls away, leaving you on a downtown curb with a suitcase, a phone at half battery, and a city map that already feels out of date.

Rain shines on the pavement. Across the street, a diner sign buzzes above morning traffic, and your only useful note is a name, an address, and a time that is getting close.

You need to find the first contact before the day slips away.

starting_known_facts: Runs a sandbox job hub suitable for modern stories.

Exists to make optional money and side-objective play available without relying on AI-invented economy actions.
